physical_fit: Generate a properly fitted broad crown wrapping the skull; visor just above brows, forehead almost invisible, eyes unobstructed; never a cap perched high on hair.
symbol: Center front crown; uniform glyph scaling, separate from visor. cap_mark_transform transforms emblem only.
crown_symbol_formula: frontBrim=central cap mask lower edge; crownBottom=frontBrim-max(8,.18*(frontBrim-capTop)); centerY=(capTop+crownBottom)/2; glyphHeight=min(42,.55*(crownBottom-capTop)); sourceglyphheight59; preserve aspect.
